island.name: Greetings & small talk
island.description: Saying hello and goodbye, introducing yourself, and keeping a light conversation going.

sentences.en: Hi, how are you?
sentences.ro: Bună, ce mai faci?
sentences.note: "Ce mai faci?" is the everyday version; with strangers use "Ce mai faceți?".

sentences.en: I'm fine, thanks, and you?
sentences.ro: Sunt bine, mulțumesc, dar tu?

sentences.en: Good morning! Did you sleep well?
sentences.ro: Bună dimineața! Ai dormit bine?

sentences.en: My name is Dmytro, nice to meet you.
sentences.ro: Mă numesc Dmytro, îmi pare bine.
sentences.note: "Îmi pare bine" literally "it seems good to me" — the standard nice-to-meet-you.

sentences.en: Where are you from?
sentences.ro: De unde ești?

sentences.en: I'm from Ukraine, but I live here now.
sentences.ro: Sunt din Ucraina, dar acum locuiesc aici.

sentences.en: I don't speak Romanian very well yet.
sentences.ro: Încă nu vorbesc foarte bine românește.
sentences.note: "Românește" (adverb) is more natural here than "limba română".

sentences.en: Sorry, can you repeat that more slowly?
sentences.ro: Scuze, poți să repeți mai rar?
sentences.note: Romanians say "mai rar" (less often) for "more slowly" in speech.

sentences.en: How was your weekend?
sentences.ro: Cum a fost weekendul tău?

sentences.en: It was quiet, I stayed at home.
sentences.ro: A fost liniștit, am stat acasă.

sentences.en: What do you do for a living?
sentences.ro: Cu ce te ocupi?
sentences.note: Literally "what do you occupy yourself with" — the normal way to ask about someone's job.

sentences.en: I work as a programmer at a small company.
sentences.ro: Lucrez ca programator la o firmă mică.

sentences.en: Long time no see!
sentences.ro: Nu ne-am văzut de mult!

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I'm in a hurry right now.
sentences.ro: Îmi pare rău, sunt grăbit acum.

sentences.en: Say hello to your family from me.
sentences.ro: Salut-o pe familia ta din partea mea.

sentences.en: See you tomorrow, have a nice evening!
sentences.ro: Ne vedem mâine, seară plăcută!

sentences.en: I don't remember your name, sorry.
sentences.ro: Nu îmi amintesc cum te cheamă, scuze.
sentences.note: "Cum te cheamă" (how are you called) is warmer than repeating "numele tău".

sentences.en: Thanks a lot, you're very kind.
sentences.ro: Mulțumesc mult, ești foarte amabil.
sentences.note: Say "amabilă" when speaking to a woman.

sentences.en: How old are you, if I may ask?
sentences.ro: Câți ani ai, dacă pot să întreb?
sentences.note: Age uses "a avea": literally "how many years do you have".

sentences.en: Have a good trip, take care!
sentences.ro: Drum bun, ai grijă de tine!
